cohort: The study included 82 post-elective caesarean section patients, randomly assigned to either a chewing gum intervention group (41 cases) or a standard post-operative care control group (41 controls).
finding: Chewing gum significantly improved the time to first bowel sound, first passage of flatus, first feeling of hunger, and first eating in post-caesarean section patients, with no significant difference observed for first defecation.
